q: will it slow my agent down?
a: never — the hook's send is time-capped and it always exits 0, by contract.

nothing — read-only local logs, no telemetry. only pixtuoid serve, if you start it, sends agent status, model, usage, repo names, which agent CLIs you have and how each is connected, and this machine's name and OS, to devices you paired on your LAN, and announces the machine's name and key fingerprint there so they can find it; they can connect or disconnect those CLIs.
